g5ela-22-1-listen-words: Two roots this week mean light. One came from Latin, one from Greek. Then long words about books, built from parts you already know. In the lantern game, build each word from its parts, and watch the lantern light up.
g5ela-22-2-listen-words: Today, decide whether each light word came from Latin or from Greek. Then sort long book words by the root at their center. Then four new lanterns to light.
g5ela-22-3-listen-words: Put the light words to work today. Then try book words you have never studied. Break each one into its parts, and work out the meaning before anyone tells you. Then four new lanterns.
g5ela-22-4-listen-words: Last day with the light roots. Explain why writers use light to talk about understanding. Then build words of your own from Greek and Latin parts, and light the last lanterns of the week.
